Scouting at the Festival.name: Scouting at the Festival
Scouting at the Festival.questStatement: The U.A. Sports Festival is where Japan's pros find their next interns, and every agency in the country has a seat in the stands. Yours can afford exactly one internship offer. The big agencies will bid on the obvious stars; somewhere in the first-year events is a student whose Quirk and nerve would fit a small agency like yours, if you can spot them before anyone else does.
Scouting at the Festival.mainObjective: Watch the first-year Sports Festival from the pros' stands and send one internship offer to the student your agency should train.

completionCondition.query: The PC has watched the Sports Festival as a pro scout and has sent an internship offer to a student, or has clearly chosen to send none.

Scouting at the Festival.questDesignBrief: Hero industry seen from the stands. Pros talk shop around the PC: rankings, sponsors, which students the top agencies want. The canon events and results belong to the Sports Festival event; the quest is about what the PC notices and decides. The chosen student (canon or original) can arrive for Internship Week later. Failure: an offer to a student who turns it down for a bigger agency, or a missed talent the PC regrets.
